project_name: MART Token Ecosystem - Integrated Agent & Compute Infrastructure Correction

correction_summary.hub_navigation_correction: REMOVED separate 'Agent' tab/submenu in Token Hub. Agent profile, AI model, mission, capability pipeline, treasury split, and compute status are now integrated directly into the main Token Hub overview breakdown alongside the live Price Chart and market metrics (agencypad.fun style layout).
correction_summary.model_selection_correction: AI Model selection is NOT edited publicly or via submenus on the Hub. Creator configures/enables the Agent and selects the AI Model during Token Launch and Add Token forms.
correction_summary.add_token_form_correction: Added optional Agent configuration form (Enable Agent toggle, Provider, Model, Mission) to both the Launch Form and the Add/Import Token Form.
correction_summary.landing_page_correction: Added an integrated Agent Feature Section to the Landing Page (Home.jsx / MartInformation) explaining autonomous ecosystem agents, DePIN compute integration, and creator launch setup without copying external branding.
correction_summary.naming_and_copy_correction: Strictly avoided words like 'mind' or copied third-party branding. Adopted original MART terminology: 'Autonomous Agent Core', 'Ecosystem Agent', 'Agent Sentinel', 'Compute Engine'.

theme_strategy.surface_treatment: Tactical dark obsidian cards with hairline borders (#232b2d or #294934) and subtle backdrop filters. Never fully transparent without backing.

token_hub_breakdown_layout.structure: Integrated Split View (Chart + Market Metrics on Left/Top, Agent Core Profile & Compute Status on Right/Side)
left_main_column: DexScreener Live Price Chart Container with timeframes (1H, 24H, 7D)
Token Stat Grid: Price, Market Cap, 24h Volume, Liquidity, Holder Count
Market Source & DexScreener Live Sync Indicator
right_agent_column: Agent Status Card: Active / Optional / Not Configured badge
Creator-Selected AI Model Display (e.g. DeepSeek R1 / Claude 3.5 Sonnet / GPT-4o)
Provider Badge (e.g. OpenAI, Anthropic, DeepSeek, Local DePIN Node)
Agent Role & Mission Overview (Defined at Launch)
Capability Pipeline Status Grid: Observe, Research, Think, Strategy, Act, Monitor, Learn
Treasury Split Metrics: Liquidity % / Buyback % / Marketing % / Gas %
Compute Engine Node Status: Standby / Simulation (Not Connected / SolNet Compute)

fields: Agent Name & Role (e.g. Sentinel, Analyst, Liquidity Scout)

add_token_form_agent_section.title: Configure Agent for Existing Solana Token
add_token_form_agent_section.note: Import any Solana token address and optionally attach an Agent Profile.

landing_page_agent_feature.description: Give your token a dedicated Agent Core configured at launch. Driven by top-tier AI models and decentralized compute networks.

cards.title: Creator Configured at Launch
cards.desc: Select your preferred AI model (DeepSeek, Claude, GPT, Llama) during token creation or when importing an existing token.

cards.title: Integrated Hub Breakdown
cards.desc: View live price charts side-by-side with your agent's capability pipeline, mission directive, and treasury split.

cards.title: DePIN Compute Infrastructure
cards.desc: Designed to run on decentralized compute nodes (Akash / Render / ElizaOS workers) for transparent autonomous execution.

compute_architecture_proposal.overview: Proposed solution for full live compute functionality matching agencypad.fun compute system.

components.name: DePIN Compute Cluster
components.role: Distributed GPU/CPU node network (Akash Network, io.net, or local Docker containers running ElizaOS agents).

components.name: TEE (Trusted Execution Environment)
components.role: Secure enclave where agent private keys and model prompts execute deterministically without creator tampering.

components.name: On-Chain Treasury Authority
components.role: Multisig or program vault controlled by TEE enclave signatures based on verified model outputs.

components.name: Event Ingestion Engine
components.role: Real-time RPC websocket listener feeding DexScreener swaps, Twitter mentions, and Solana program logs into the agent context.

component_instructions.data_test_ids: Mandatory kebab-case data-testid on all interactive buttons, inputs, forms, and token hub components.

universal_guidelines_for_main_agent: Preserve original MART visuals (Deep Obsidian #080B0D, Emerald #00EFA0, JetBrains Mono, Outfit heading font).
Do NOT create a separate /token/:address/agent route or tab. Integrate the agent breakdown directly into the main Token Hub view.
Ensure Launch form and Add Token form have the optional Agent configuration module.
Ensure Landing page includes the agent feature explanation section using original MART branding.
Never use the word 'mind' or external copied branding.
Include data-testid on all interactive elements.
